description: The river of nhflow_3d_mb_open_faces_mpi2 (three blocks in a row, non-hydrostatic, two ranks) as a tidal channel: a Riemann edge on the -i face of block 1 with a harmonic tide (zone 1, background 1: 5 mm, 2 s, 0.5 s ramp) and a Flather edge on the +i face of block 2 at still water (zone 2, background 2), the zones placed on the blocks with B 522. The same solution as one block of 48 x 10 cells with the zones on its x- and x+ edges (iowave, DIVEMesh C 11 1, C 14 2), see Dropbox validation 01_block_edges.
covers: nhflow_amr::patch_objects: open_xm, open_xp, B 90 of a block with edge zones
